StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssisted.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue cache adapter on Gnosis (agent-fed; ADR 0014, sibling of EtherFiWithdrawalQueueAssisted). Mutable cache of (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples — never amounts — admin+assistant = chainConfig.admin at deploy (assisted-family AccessControl; ASSISTANT_ROLE submits, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE administers; ADR 0015); the kpk-agents submitter feeds tuples discovered from ExitQueueEntered events. GNO-denominated (Gnosis StakeWise vaults settle in GNO, the registered+Chainlink-priced underlyingToken); values from live reads (calculateExitedAssets.exitedAssets + convertToAssets(leftShares)) with calculateExitedAssets(receiver=account) as the on-chain ownership check. Reports 0 until the agent submits tuples. 04 reads vaultsRegistry/underlyingToken/receiptSymbol; the display name and positionId are hardcoded in the contract. receiptSymbol names StakeWise's Gnosis LST (osGNO) for the position label '<receiptSymbol> Exit Queue'. vaultsRegistry verified on-chain (reports all 3 Gnosis vaults registered). This adapter was missing from the previous Gnosis deploy.
